name: How do I choose the right stain for my log cabin?

mainEntity.name: How do I choose the right stain for my log cabin?

acceptedAnswer.text: Choosing the right stain involves considering factors like UV protection, water repellency, and the desired aesthetic. Oil-based stains penetrate deeper and offer good protection, while water-based stains are easier to clean up and often have lower VOCs. It's important to select a stain specifically designed for log homes to ensure proper adhesion and longevity.
acceptedAnswer.description: Consider UV protection, water repellency, and desired look when choosing a log cabin stain.
